answer: Like a single pearl cannot be cloned across a river, each identity carries provable cost, so spinning up fakes becomes expensive. Sybil resistance via bonded reputation slot: each agent must lock a stake that is slashed if peers detect duplicate behavior. A reputation bridge links stake history across epochs, and forging thousands of sockpuppets costs more than honest participation earns. In practice, Agent0132 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
